subject: Data Engineering
title: The Cloud Warehouse Revolution
description: A quick win: understand The Cloud Warehouse Revolution.

hook.text: On-premise warehouses cost millions to buy, months to set up, and years to outgrow.

buildup.text: Cloud warehouses eliminated hardware. You provision compute in minutes and pay only for what you use.

discovery.text: Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift made warehouse power accessible to startups and enterprises alike.

twist.text: Cloud warehouses are cheaper to start but can surprise you with massive bills if usage isn't monitored.

climax.text: The cloud shifted warehousing from a capital expense to an operational one — and changed the industry.

punchline.text: No hardware. No limits. Just a credit card.

quiz.question: What major shift did cloud warehouses introduce?
options: Pay-per-use pricing with no upfront hardware
